review:
Candy meets pirates on a 6x5 grid with an extra reel across the top. Eight or more matching symbols anywhere win up to 100x, with tumbles, and top-reel symbols can carry multiplier overlays up to 500x that add together.

Four to six scatters give 10 to 30 free spins plus an instant prize up to 2,000x, with at least one multiplier overlay every spin. Super scatters on the top reel trigger super free spins where every top symbol carries a multiplier. 96.53% RTP.
